methods.fixtures: One root-seeded source coin per actor, normal issuance and held-backing bypassed; one extra smoke claim excluded from burst counts.
methods.finalitySeconds: Own submission to finalized notification plus receipt/block lookup, measured only for successful watches.
methods.settledAtSeconds: First wave start to last watch result; includes time spent on the inter-wave receipt gate.
methods.elapsedSeconds: First wave start through wave gates, observer shutdown and final state queries; excludes setup, final aggregate receipt audit, offline verification and recovery.
methods.readiness: Not applicable to claiming existing coins.
methods.verification: Raw extrinsic hashes, indexed System.ExtrinsicSuccess and Coinage.CoinTransferred events, saved finality views of both nodes, actor coin state checks. No independent consensus/storage proof.
methods.singleBurstWaveVerifiedFlag: A false waves[].verified on the single-burst run means there was no intermediate wave gate. Its final aggregate claim-burst-audit passed with all 10000 receipts.

methods: Claim-only workload with root-seeded, asset-backed coins; no issuance or wallet behavior tested.
One real signed Coinage.transfer per actor; no retries or additional waves.
Receipts rechecked against raw extrinsics, indexed System success and expected Coinage events; both local RPC finality views saved.
Finality percentiles describe per-claim watch receipt latency; the last receipt is measured from wave start.
Stage duration includes post-burst state reads but excludes preparation, the final receipt audit and recovery.
Queue gauges and host resources are five-second samples; peak values may miss shorter spikes.
Local RPC consistency checks are not independent consensus or state-proof verification.
A successful offered burst is a measured lower bound, not the absolute hardware ceiling or sustainable TPS.
